method: Independent source-first audit of the complete summary against all relevant local Law sections. Read the common and four base faction chapters and relevant components, glossary, map and base-character appendices. Visually inspected PDF pages 5, 9, 10, 24 and 28, including item glyphs. No questions, answer keys, reader answers, grades, earlier audits or other QA artifacts were read.

checked_claims.notes: Scope matches the requested base-game audit; ordinary victory is immediate at 30 VP.
Listed base components, counts, item names and exclusions from faction/enemy pieces agree with the source.

checked_claims.claim_group: Standard Setup and two-player dominance removal
checked_claims.notes: Three-card hands, four occupied ruin slots, item supply, faction setup order and Vagabond-only ruin population are correct.
The seven item symbols translate to 2 boots, 2 bags, 1 crossbow, 1 hammer, 2 swords, 2 tea, 2 coins.
Keep, initial garrison, building geography, supply and building-track filling agree.
Corner restriction and preference, six starting warriors, roost, chosen leader and Vizier setup agree.
Three supporters are additional to the ordinary starting hand; initial pieces and absence of officers agree.

checked_claims.claim_group: Vagabond setup and ruin glyph translation
checked_claims.notes: Quest display, forest placement, four R items, hidden stacks, S items and Indifferent markers agree.
Base reach values, player-count thresholds and adventurous 17+ exception agree.
Turn structure, phase boundaries, last-step restriction, compound March and faction phase orders agree; detailed battle section supplies the specific timing rules.
Ordinary rule counts warriors plus buildings, ties, Eyrie qualification and Vagabond non-rule are correct.
Positive group, path adjacency, ruling either endpoint, repeated moves, forest adjacency, Winter river and Vagabond exceptions agree.

checked_claims.claim_group: Crafting cost, timing, limits and effects
checked_claims.notes: Crafting icons, one activation per piece, faction pieces, immediate/persistent effects, supply limitation and duplicate prohibition agree.
Enemy defender, matching ambushes, foil, two immediate hits, attacker-removal early end and before-roll ordering agree.

checked_claims.claim_group: Battle dice, hit caps, timing and extra/ignored hits
checked_claims.notes: Higher/lower results, equal dice, warrior caps, defending Alliance, Vagabond swords, defenseless and uncapped extra hits agree.
Warriors-first removal, own removal-trigger order, counted hits, defender scoring and item damage agree.

checked_claims.claim_group: Finite pieces, partial completion and destinations
checked_claims.notes: Maximum possible manipulation, costs/prerequisites exception, Decree completeness, removal timing and track directions agree.
Placement versus movement, permanent loss of keep, matching hospital card, clearing origin and keep destination agree.
Wood production, three actions plus birds, March, once-per-turn Recruit, supply handling, wood-connected ruled build payment and Overwork agree.
Draw bonuses and five-card limit agree.

checked_claims.claim_group: Eyrie Disdain, Birdsong and New Roost
checked_claims.notes: One point per crafted item, extra crafting effects, Emergency Orders, Decree additions and legal New Roost placement agree.
Column order, card order, source suit for Move, recruit/build restrictions, full-action requirement, Vizier losses, leader recycling, end of Daylight and Evening scoring agree.
Vizier columns and abilities, including Charismatic full two-warrior recruitment and Despot bonus, agree.
Supporters privacy, suit-only spending, separation from hand, no-base capacity and overflow agree.
Movement/removal triggers, matching hand-card payment, no-card reveal/draw, capacity, bird supporter losses and rounded-up officer losses agree.
Choice prerequisites, two supporters, removal-before-placement, printed-base suit recruitment, officer placement, sympathy adjacency, Martial Law and maximum possible placement agree.
Hand versus supporters, training officers, operation allowance and repetition, Recruit/Organize, placement requirements, scoring and draw/discard agree.
Pawn permanence, full-removal exception, independent damage/exhaustion states, track movement, three-item track limits and damage choice agree.
Tea refresh calculation, no recursive tea bonus, extra three refreshes, damaged-state preservation and free Slip agree.
Boot costs, hostile extra cost, forest restrictions, sword exhaustion and undamaged sword cap agree.
Torch/item/card costs, eligible clearing/player, scoring, item destination, empty item-box Aid, quest reward choice and replacement agree.
Warrior precedence for Strike, non-battle limitation, repair face preservation, hammer-per-icon crafting and same-clearing suit requirements agree.

Same-turn Aid counts, single-use improvement credit, allied Aid points, one-faction ally powers, no allied assistance against itself, end-of-battle allied-loss comparison, normal hostility and Infamy exceptions agree.
Forest rest repairs damaged items only; draw always follows; coins bonus, discard, final capacity, bag allowance and permanent removals agree.

checked_claims.source_refs: V.1.1–3.2, p.28 (PDF visually inspected); 9.5.7, p.10; G.22, p.25
checked_claims.notes: All starting items, torch costs, Steal random card, Day Labor bird choice, Hideout repair and immediate phase end agree.
Immediate victory, clockwise tie resolution, ten-point activation, dominance win timing, card permanence, spending destination and bird dominance payment agree.
Four-player minimum, own Daylight and ten-point activation, lowest-score partner/ties, stop-scoring, shared win, enemy status and Hostile reset agree.

checked_claims.claim_group: Precedence, cards, information, force and glossary
checked_claims.notes: Wild birds, forced matching, deck reshuffle, public hand size, private contents, inspection, deals, force and piece/card terminology agree.

checked_claims.source_refs: Chapters 1–9; C.1; Appendix G; M.1–2; V.1–3
checked_claims.notes: Reference repeats the detailed rules consistently. No important in-scope rule omission requiring correction was found.
